stretch.task: Calculate mesh links for six nodes and compare with a six-device star.
stretch.hint: A star has one link from each device to a central switch.
stretch.answer: Full mesh: 6×5÷2=15; six peripherals in a star use six links to the switch.

mastery.task: Design a loop that tabulates full-mesh and star link counts for n=2 to 8 and identifies where the mesh needs at least twice as many.
mastery.hint: Compute both values on each iteration and compare.
mastery.answer: If n is number of peripheral/device nodes: mesh n(n−1)/2, star n; mesh≥2×star from n≥5. State star counting assumption.
